crossRefs.note: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?
Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

translations.web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
translations.bsb: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
translations.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
translations.asv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.
